title: Nature in sentences
summary: Inflect the lemma. Adjectives and prepositions fix the case and number.

forest-gen.sentenceGloss: A small house stands near the forest.

river-gen.sentenceGloss: It is a five-minute walk from the river to the village.

lake-gen.sentenceGloss: Trees grow on the shore of the lake.
lake-gen.note: Genitive: на березі озера, on the shore of the lake.

mountains-loc.sentenceGloss: Our friends are holidaying in high mountains.
mountains-loc.note: Locative plural: у високих горах, the second case plural.

pines-inst.sentenceGloss: The path runs between tall pines.
pines-inst.note: Instrumental: between the pines, in the instrumental.

willow-inst.sentenceGloss: There is a bench under the old willow.
willow-inst.note: Instrumental: під takes the instrumental for a position.

oak-gen.sentenceGloss: The hikers stopped near the old oak.

lily-genpl.sentenceGloss: There is a bunch of lilies of the valley in the picture.
lily-genpl.note: Genitive plural: a bunch of lilies of the valley.

flower-acc.sentenceGloss: The girl drew a bright flower.
flower-acc.note: Accusative: what was drawn takes the accusative.

meadow-loc.sentenceGloss: In summer livestock graze on the mountain meadow.
meadow-loc.note: Locative singular: полонина in the second case singular.

reserve-gen.sentenceGloss: We arrived at the nature reserve.

nature-inst.sentenceGloss: The artist admires the local natural landscape.
nature-inst.note: Instrumental: the instrumental names what the artist admires.
